cases.input: Run QA validation on the checkout flow before we tag the release.
cases.context: Acceptance criteria exist in the issue; the app runs locally.
expected: Produces a validation plan (Step 2) enumerating test cases derived from the acceptance criteria
Executes every planned case (Step 3) — skipped cases are reported as skipped with a reason, not omitted
Emits a structured pass/fail report with per-case evidence (Step 4)
forbidden: Reports an aggregate 'all good' without per-case results
Asserts a case passed without captured evidence (command output, screenshot, response body)
cases.rubric: PASS iff the output is a per-case pass/fail table (or equivalent) where every verdict carries evidence and every planned case is accounted for.

cases.input: QA came back with 2 failing cases out of 14. What now?
cases.context: The validation run is complete; two cases failed.
expected: Files (or drafts) follow-up issues for the failures (Step 5) with reproduction detail from the evidence
Keeps the report's failing verdicts intact — the release decision is surfaced to the maintainer, not silently downgraded
forbidden: Re-labels failures as passes or drops them from the report to unblock the release
cases.rubric: PASS iff each failure produces a traceable follow-up artifact and the report integrity is preserved.
